ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: JChat uses your photos for your profile, posts, messages and Match.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: JChat uses the camera to take photos for chat, posts and your profile, and to scan inventory barcodes.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: JChat needs access to your microphone to send voice messages.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: JChat uses your location to show nearby venues on the map and to connect to nearby card readers.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: JChat uses Face ID to unlock the app when you turn on biometric lock.
ios.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: JChat uses Bluetooth to connect to Stripe Terminal card readers for in-person payments.
ios.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: JChat uses Bluetooth to communicate with card readers for in-person payments.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: JChat uses the local network to connect to WiFi-enabled card readers.
